paper_title: New Constraints on ALP Electron and Photon Couplings from ArgoNeuT and the MiniBooNE Beam Dump
notes: Paper sets new constraints on both ALP-photon (gaγ, Fig.7) and ALP-electron (gae, Fig.8) couplings from MiniBooNE dump-mode data (1.86e20 POT), with ArgoNeuT projections. Pre-analysis hint indicates AxionElectron; reported here as the gae limit at 2σ C.L. Note the 2σ is interpreted as ~95% CL. Data points approximate, read from Fig.8 and benchmark masses in text (e.g. ma=16 MeV resonant peak at gae~3e-8). The gaγ limit (AxionPhoton) is an alternative coupling type also presented in this paper, hence reduced confidence. Beam dump, not haloscope, so no DM density assumed. | Auto-corrected masses: GeV→eV (÷1e9) (×1.000e-09, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-03)|)
